name: ModelVariant119_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant119_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (waves of 16 textured blades turning around the camera part, each wave growing and fading over the row's fade time, with a full-screen flash at the start. Commands from 100 up also queue a tint during the first half of the slot animation window; once the animation passes the middle of the window, the entry moves the camera and restarts both slot animations); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-119 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant119_entry.c with GRAPHICS_DEFAULT_HEIGHT, VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
